test_inputs.explanation: Values extracted from the agent's visited filter URLs (steps 6-8). The base64-encoded filter payloads decode to query parameters: customer_id[from]=100 and customer_id[to]=200 (steps 7/8), firstname=Alice and email=alice@example.com, type=c (mapped to 'Customer'), last_activity[from]=2026-02-02 05:00, and last_url=/checkout/cart. Other fields were not present so left empty.
